ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.Enforce_Termination_Reason_Rules , Account__r.WO_Asset__r.NSP_Written_Term_recd__c , ( TEXT( NSP_Type__c ) = "Renewal Probability" ) , OR( ISBLANK( TEXT( Primary_Term_Reason__c ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Sub_Term_Reason__c ) ) , ( LEN( Termination_Key_Points__c ) = 0 ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Eligible_To_Return_To_Insperity_At_Time__c ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Termination_Anticipated__c ) ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Did_Client_Go_To_A_Competitor__c ) ) , ( LEN( Why_Why_Not__c ) = 0 ) , AND( ( TEXT( Did_Client_Go_To_A_Competitor__c ) = "Yes" ) , ISBLANK( TEXT( Competitor__c ) ) ) , AND( ( TEXT( Competitor__c ) = "Other" ) , ISBLANK( Other_Competitor__c ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must complete the Termination Information section when an Asset linked to the primary Account in the Renewal Probability Account Group has 'Written Termination Notice Received' selected.
